verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, and a buyer could reasonably ask whether its inbox also handles SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only email, calendar and contacts features (JMAP, filters, templates, aliases, masked email, scheduled send). It never documents ingesting SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat messages into the same inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
